title: Spire Legacy
description:
Every climb ends. Your bloodline grows.

A solo Slay the Spire 2 character by CapeKid: Knight, Mage and Ranger heirs, 82 reward cards per class on regular or 85 on public-beta, with 34 shared family cards plus class specialties and three basic starters, 360 registered illustrated cards and upgrades, 61 inherited traits, genetic starter changes and permanent Family Manor upgrades. Name your family, choose its banner and select three new heirs after each climb. Purchases require explicit confirmation; a temporary crown editor supports playtesting.

Requires Slay the Spire 2 and BaseLib. Rogue Legacy 2 is not required. Trait icons, class badges, character sprites, portraits and card illustrations are original mod artwork included in the package. No content extraction or game-derived assets are included. Windows and Linux x86_64 support, including Steam Deck; regular/public-beta compatibility; solo play only.

Includes seven exclusive relic drops supporting family and class synergies, original class-specific Architect ending dialogue and recent card/trait balance changes. Native checks pass on regular v0.107.1 and public-beta v0.111.0. Physical Deck and full-run balance retesting remain needed for each release. Original code and artwork: MIT, CapeKid. Slay the Spire 2 belongs to Mega Crit; Rogue Legacy 2 inspiration belongs to Cellar Door Games.
changeNote: 1.0.23: Fix Ironclad death visuals when abandoning an Heir run outside combat. Startup, rest-site and shop endings now use the ended heir's original class sprite, inherited scale and trait appearance on regular and public-beta.
